child_list.content: Three turtles
child_list.name: 题目

elements.content:
Three turtles decided to have a cup of coffee. Just as they got into the cafe, it started to rain. The biggest turtle said to the smallest one, “Go home and get an umbrella.” The little turtle replied, “I will go if you don’t drink my coffee.” “We won’t drink your coffee,” the other two promised. Two years later, the big turtle said to the middle turtle, “Well, I guess he

isn’t coming back, so we can drink his coffee.” Just then a voice shouted from outside the door, “If you drink my coffee, I won’t go.”

elements.content:
Hello, hello, hello. Hi, hi, hi.

Good morning to you, good morning to you.

It’s a beautiful day, let’s go out and play.

Good afternoon to you, good afternoon to you.

It’s a nice day, let’s whistle a tune.

Good evening to you, good evening to you.

It’s wonderful night, let’s dance in the moonlight

child_list.content: 三只乌龟
child_list.name: 题目

child_list.content:
三只乌龟决定去喝杯咖啡。他们刚进咖啡馆，天就下起雨来了。最大的乌龟对最小的乌龟说：“回家去拿把伞。”小乌龟回答说：“如果你们不喝我的咖啡，我就去。”“我们不喝你的咖啡，”另外两只乌龟答应道。两年后，大乌龟对中乌龟说：“好吧，我想他不会回来了，所以我

们可以喝他的咖啡了。” 就在这时，门外传来一个声音：“如果你们喝了我的咖啡，我就不去了。”

child_list.content: 你好，你好，你好
child_list.name: 题目

child_list.content:
你好，你好，你好。嗨，嗨，嗨。

早上好，早上好。

美好的一天，我们出去玩吧。

下午好，下午好。

美好的一天，让我们吹口哨吧。

晚上好，晚上好。

美好的夜晚，让我们在月光下跳舞吧。
